comment: Back-test corpus for Sr. Botany (Baby Bullet-Q). The 5 Model Guess Papers (book pp.60-64) each print an 'Ans-Page Index' column citing P <page>(<global qno>). Every citation must resolve to an authored card. The Bullet Model Paper (pp.54-59) restates bank answers with no citations and is NOT authored. Transcribed 2026-08-28 directly from the page images.
